newsitem.title: USA: Access Health to take Q4 charge.
newsitem.headline: Access Health to take Q4 charge.

text.p: Access Health Inc said Thursday it expects to incur a one-time pre-tax charge in the range of about $2 million to $3 million in the fourth quarter of fiscal 1997.

The company said the charge results from plans to move its corporate headquarters to Broomfield, Colorado, where most of its senior management team is based, from Rancho Cordova, California as well as severance costs associated with organizational changes.
The company's fourth quarter ends September 30.

Access also said it appointed Joseph Tallman as chief executive officer. Tallman has served as president and chief operating officer since April of this year. Tallman founded and and was president and chief executive of Informed Access Systems Inc which completed its merger with Access in November 1996.
Timothy Connor was named as chief financial officer. Prior to joining Informed Access Systems in July 1996, Connor was a managing director in investment banking with Lehman Brothers.
The company was not immediately available to comment on who Tallman and Connor replaced.
